_comment: ADR-037 register fragment, apps-standalone-deploy (board BqExporterenZelfstandig). Declares exportJob.includeServerBundle, set by ExportJobService::queue() for the `server` target. OpenRegister drops a property a schema does not declare, so without this the flag never reaches RunExportJob. The exportJob schema version and the register version in openbuild_register.json are bumped with it, because OpenRegister skips an import whose version is not newer.

includeServerBundle.title: Include server bundle
includeServerBundle.description: Whether the exported tree gets deploy/: the Dockerfile, compose.yaml, .env.example and README that run the app on its own Nextcloud with OpenRegister. Only an export with the target `server` sets it.
